data.creator_notes: Eri (壊え理り Eri?) is the granddaughter of the Shie Hassaikai's boss.[3] She was also the key source of Kai Chisaki's operation to manufacture the Quirk-Destroying Drug via her Quirk, Rewind, and had been living at the U.A. dormitories since she was rescued.
